name: codebase_map
description: Generates memory/CODEBASE-MAP.md from the source: each tools module's purpose and local imports, the reverse 'called by' index, every skill and the tool it drives, and each episode folder. A content fingerprint makes --check fail as soon as the map is stale.

metadata.standaloneReason: Mechanical generator with one deterministic output and a fingerprint gate; it needs no procedural judgement, so a skill would only restate the command.

check.description: Verify the map on disk against a fresh scan; exit 1 when it is missing or stale.

stdout.description: Print the generated map instead of writing memory/CODEBASE-MAP.md.
